description: This file implements the priority queue (pqueue) operations used in a merging algorithm, including functions for adding, removing, and releasing elements in a priority queue of 'pq_entry' structures. It appears to be part of a larger system that handles reference tables, likely for version control or database operations.

methods.name: int pq_less(struct pq_entry * a,struct pq_entry * b)
methods.description: Compares two 'pq_entry' structures based on their associated 'reftable_record' comparison, returning an integer indicating ordering.

methods.name: int merged_iter_pqueue_remove(struct merged_iter_pqueue * pq,struct pq_entry * out)
methods.description: Removes the top element from the priority queue, maintaining heap property, and optionally outputs the removed element.

methods.name: int merged_iter_pqueue_add(struct merged_iter_pqueue * pq,const struct pq_entry * e)
methods.description: Adds a new 'pq_entry' to the priority queue, maintaining the heap property.

methods.name: void merged_iter_pqueue_release(struct merged_iter_pqueue * pq)
methods.description: Releases resources allocated for the priority queue and resets its state.
